title: Add HTTPS and Re-enable Secure Session Cookies
description:
Currently running over HTTP with session cookies set to secure: false. Need to set up HTTPS and re-enable secure cookies for production security.

Required:
- Point domain to 5.78.83.163
- Install Let's Encrypt SSL
- Configure nginx reverse proxy
- Update session cookie config to secure: true
- Update OAuth callback URLs to HTTPS

See github-issues/https-setup.md for full details.

title: Fix GitHub OAuth login (duplicate /api prefix)
description:
GitHub login was broken due to duplicate /api prefix in OAuth URL.

Issue: Login.tsx was appending /api/auth/github to VITE_API_URL which already contained /api
Result: http://5.78.83.163:8000/api/api/auth/github → 404 Not Found

Fix: Updated Login.tsx to use VITE_API_URL + /auth/github (no duplicate /api)
Deployed: Frontend rebuilt and deployed to production

title: Set up browser automation for agent testing
description:
Enable the agent to test the UI independently via browser automation.

Current state:
- Chromium installed on the machine
- Browser control tool available but service not working
- Agent can't currently test UI changes without human intervention

Required:
- Troubleshoot browser control service
- Configure headless/visible mode preferences
- Test basic browser operations (navigate, click, screenshot)
- Document browser testing workflow for agent

Benefits:
- Agent can verify UI changes independently
- Catch visual/interaction bugs before deployment
- Faster feedback loop for frontend work
